item.title: MoneyGram Launches Ramps on Solana for Global Cash Access
item.summary: MoneyGram has launched its Ramps product on the Solana blockchain, expanding access to its global fiat on- and off-ramp infrastructure for developers building blockchain-based financial applications. The integration allows developers to connect Solana wallets, applications and exchanges to MoneyGram’s cash network through a single application programming interface.
